_note: Expected results are listed in the order the Results screen must show them: high → official → moderate → low → none_reported → not_in_database, then herb order, then drug order. entry is the interaction id, or null when the pair is not in the database. Keep tests/test-cases.md in step with this file.

cases.name: Mrs Wong (demo case)
cases.story: Fictional 72-year-old with atrial fibrillation, on warfarin and amlodipine, who buys danshen.

cases.name: Nothing in our database
cases.story: Goji, sanqi and safflower with blood pressure medicine. We have no records, so every card must say 'not in database', never 'safe'.

cases.name: Statin + red yeast rice
cases.story: Takes simvastatin for cholesterol and adds red yeast rice 'to help naturally'. Matches through the statin class.

cases.name: Several flagged pairs
cases.story: Heart failure and atrial fibrillation: warfarin, aspirin, digoxin and furosemide, plus dong quai, ginkgo and liquorice.

cases.name: American ginseng with warfarin
cases.story: Drinks 花旗參 tea daily and is on warfarin after a heart valve operation.

cases.name: Asian ginseng with warfarin and clopidogrel
cases.story: Takes Korean ginseng with warfarin and clopidogrel after a stent. Warfarin shows the Hospital Authority's caution over the team's Low rating (sources disagree). Clopidogrel has no record and must not look safe.

cases.name: Liquorice with furosemide only
cases.story: On furosemide for swollen ankles, takes a herbal tea containing 甘草. Matches through the diuretic class, for both the team rating and the EMA caution.

cases.name: Red yeast rice with two statins
cases.story: Switched from atorvastatin to rosuvastatin and still has both on the list, plus red yeast rice. Both statins must match.

cases.name: Ginkgo with aspirin and clopidogrel
cases.story: Takes ginkgo for memory, on aspirin and clopidogrel. Both show an official caution: ginkgo + aspirin quotes Health Canada and the EMA over the team rating (sources disagree); ginkgo + clopidogrel has no team rating, only the official quotes.

cases.name: Danshen, sanqi and safflower with warfarin and aspirin
cases.story: A 'blood circulation' herbal mix (丹參, 三七, 紅花) taken with warfarin and aspirin. Every pair now has a record: danshen + warfarin is High with the Hospital Authority leaflet quoted (it names danshen); then two Moderate and three Low. The HA warfarin leaflet's general 'any TCM' advice appears on the sanqi and safflower cards as Hospital Authority advice, not as an official caution.
